responsibility: This is the main implementation file of GCC’s MIPS backend. It owns the target’s core code-generation logic: target hooks, ABI and ISA handling, addressing and relocation decisions, symbol classification, constant expansion, builtins, register and reload rules, prologue/epilogue and frame layout, call and PIC/$gp management, asm output, scheduling helpers, vector/MSA utilities, and many target-specific expansion and cost routines, making it the central executable backend companion to mips.h and mips.md.
same_name_distinction: Within the mips same-name group, this is the compiled implementation file: it defines the backend’s target-hook functions, helper routines, and final targetm initializer, rather than declaring interfaces like mips.h, describing RTL patterns like mips.md, or declaring command-line options like mips.opt.
